problem_analysis: The core challenge lies in jointly optimizing INA switch placement and worker-to-aggregator assignment under strict hardware and network constraints. Key data structures include job-specific worker and PS mappings, switch tier classifications, precomputed shortest paths, and per-link bandwidth capacities. The solution must balance INA deployment budget, switch processing limits, and link bandwidth saturation while ensuring valid routing assignments. The critical insight is that placement and assignment are interdependent: poor placement creates hotspots, while poor assignment wastes INA capacity.
strategy_overview: The solution follows a constructive, single-pass pipeline: first, prioritize candidate switches for INA based on topological influence and job proximity; second, assign workers to aggregation points using a greedy, bottleneck-aware strategy; finally, assemble the solution using the precomputed components. The approach leverages existing data preprocessing and path-finding utilities to avoid redundant computation.

function_architecture.name: _decide_ina_placement_candidates
function_architecture.strategic_role: Selects the most strategically impactful switches for INA deployment by evaluating their potential to alleviate aggregation bottlenecks across multiple jobs, based on topological centrality and job connectivity.

outputs.name: ina_placement_candidates
outputs.description: A ranked list of switch Node IDs eligible for INA, prioritized by systemic impact.

member_variables_read.description: All switches eligible for INA placement.

member_variables_read.name: self.allPathDict
member_variables_read.description: Precomputed shortest paths between all node pairs.

member_variables_written.name: self._ina_placement_priority
member_variables_written.description: Final ordered list of switches selected for INA, respecting the budget constraint.

function_architecture.name: _assign_workers_to_aggregators
function_architecture.strategic_role: Assigns each worker to a single aggregation point—either an INA-enabled switch or the PS—while respecting assignment validity and minimizing end-to-end congestion by prioritizing low-latency and high-capacity paths.

outputs.name: worker_agg_id
outputs.description: Mapping from job and worker index to chosen aggregation node ID.

function_architecture.name: solve_with_heuristic
function_architecture.strategic_role: Orchestrates the complete solution pipeline by executing the placement and assignment steps in sequence, then constructs and returns the final solution object matching the required schema.

outputs.description: Final solution object containing INA placement and worker assignments.
